state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 8 (`authenticate` and AD's reasons) is done**: `Ldap\Connection::authenticate` is on `main`, and both Stage 8 checks pass against `samba-ad`. Stages 1 to 5 and 7 are done. Stage 4 is done except for a CA that a program supplies. Stage 6 is done except wiring the schema into the readers. Stage 9 (the AD extras) is next, and none of it is written.

**On `main`**: everything Stage 7 listed, plus `crate::ldap::authenticate` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs`, its module doc's paragraph on logins): it dials the block's URL list again, or the address `open` pinned (`Held::redial`), binds, unbinds and closes. `login_fault` gives every `InvalidCredentials` one message. `walk` takes the member and the refusal it throws. `rule:security/ldap-pool-is-bound-as-its-block` is now `shipped`. Samba really answers `data 773` and `data 533`, and `ad_bind_sub_codes_map_to_kinds` asserts both.

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`, and plain LDAP at 16389. Write cases add and delete their own entries, and each case and test uses its own names because they run at the same time: OUs `Shop`/`Blog`/`Store`/`Framework`/`Example`/`Catalog`/`Library`/`Gallery`/`Studio` at the root, and each test user `CN=<name>,OU=<name>` in an OU of its own (`Team`, `Editors`, `Visitors`, `Members`, `Readers` in Rust; `Staff`, `Authors`, `Owners`, `Clients` in cases). Grep the name across `tests/conformance/core/ldap-*.nvst` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs` before taking one. `login_peer` in the Rust test is a loopback peer that sees each login on its own connection.

items.text: **Sort and a VLV window as search options** (ADR 0278 § 11; one attribute, `.473` and the VLV control, with `descending`). The controls go beside `PAGED_RESULTS` at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/proto.rs:26` and into `SearchRequest` at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/proto.rs:863`; the options go in `SEARCH_OPTIONS` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:295`. Closes `sort_and_a_vlv_window_return_the_requested_slice`.

**Deleted objects and DirSync since a cookie** (ADR 0278 § 11): the show-deleted control as a search option, and `changes(Filter, ?ChangesOptions): Changes`, whose cursor read is at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs:398`. Closes the deleted-objects and DirSync tests and `tests/conformance/core/ldap-sync-cookie.nvst`.

**A write to a Global Catalog block throws before it is sent** (ADR 0278 § 11). The writes start at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/write.rs:59`, and nothing in `crates/nvs-config/src/ldap.rs` marks a block as a Global Catalog yet. Closes the last Stage 9 test; `bun nv loop --list --stage 9` names all four.

backlog: The readers take the base type from the schema (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`), Stage 6's last item; `crate::ldap::schema` is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs`.
A CA that a program supplies to `Ldap::open` (Stage 4's remainder; `tls_ca_file: None` in `nvs_core_ldap_open`).
Stage 10, the feature proofs: `bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Ldap'` lists what each class owes, `authenticate` included.
